sections.heading: Contrast
sections.body:
- *pero* (but): *Es caro, pero es bueno.*
- *sin embargo* (however) — starts a new sentence or clause, with commas: *Es caro. Sin embargo, lo voy a comprar.*
- *aunque* + indicative (although — a fact): *Aunque es caro, lo voy a comprar.* (You'll learn *aunque* + subjunctive in B2.)
- *en cambio* (on the other hand): *Mi hermano es alto; yo, en cambio, soy bajo.*
- *sino* (but rather — after a negative): *No es rojo, sino naranja.*

sections.heading: Addition
sections.body: *además* (besides, also, moreover): *Es barato y, además, está cerca.* *también* (also), *incluso* (even): *Incluso mi abuela usa WhatsApp.* *ni siquiera* (not even): *Ni siquiera me llamó.*

sections.heading: Cause
sections.body:
- *porque* (because) — usually in the middle: *No salí porque llovía.*
- *como* (since / as) — at the **start** of the sentence: *Como llovía, no salí.*
- *ya que / puesto que* (since, given that): *Ya que estás aquí, ayúdame.*
- *por* + noun / infinitive: *No salí por la lluvia.*

sections.heading: Consequence
sections.body: *así que* (so): *Llovía, así que no salí.* *por eso* (that's why): *Estaba cansado; por eso me acosté temprano.* *por lo tanto* (therefore — more formal). *entonces* (so, then): *Entonces, ¿vienes o no?* *o sea* (I mean, in other words): *No tengo dinero, o sea, no puedo ir.*

examples: Es caro, pero es bueno.
It's expensive, but it's good.
Es caro. Sin embargo, lo voy a comprar.
It's expensive. However, I'm going to buy it.
Aunque es caro, lo voy a comprar.
Although it's expensive, I'm going to buy it.
Mi hermano es alto; yo, en cambio, soy bajo.
My brother is tall; I, on the other hand, am short.
No es rojo, sino naranja.
It isn't red, but orange.
Es barato y, además, está cerca.
It's cheap, and besides, it's nearby.
Incluso mi abuela usa WhatsApp.
Even my grandmother uses WhatsApp.
Ni siquiera me llamó.
He didn't even call me.
No salí porque llovía.
I didn't go out because it was raining.
Como llovía, no salí.
Since it was raining, I didn't go out.
Ya que estás aquí, ayúdame.
Since you're here, help me.
No salí por la lluvia.
I didn't go out because of the rain.
Llovía, así que no salí.
It was raining, so I didn't go out.
Estaba cansado; por eso me acosté temprano.
I was tired; that's why I went to bed early.
No hay suficientes datos; por lo tanto, no podemos decidir.
There isn't enough data; therefore, we can't decide.
Entonces, ¿vienes o no?
So, are you coming or not?
No tengo dinero, o sea, no puedo ir.
I don't have money, I mean, I can't go.
No quiero té, sino café.
I don't want tea, but coffee.
